*You channel holy energy to smite a foe and heal an ally.*

| **Magic, [Melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee), [Strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike), Weapon** |               **Main action** |
|----------------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee) 1**                   | **🎯 One creature or object** |

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Might](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/might):**

- **≤11:** 5 + M holy damage
- **12-16:** 8 + M holy damage
- **17+:** 11 + M holy damage

**Effect:** You can spend a [Recovery](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/recoveries) to allow yourself or one ally within 10 squares to regain [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) equal to your [recovery value](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/recoveries).
